_readme: AI text prompts (sent to Perchance's ai-text-plugin). The game fills in the {placeholders} and sends the result as the instruction.

Placeholders: {name} {race} {age} {appearance} {clothing} {outfit} {personality} {traits} {trust} {lewd} {mood} {service} {stance} {client} {setting} {house} {relationship} {guidance} {hook} {backstory} {date} {situation} {lust} {other} {otherDesc} {dynamic} {outcome} (how it ends: did she finish, was she satisfied, demon feeding/drain; worded by "outcomes" below; if a custom template lacks {outcome}, it is added to {guidance}).
{other} / {otherDesc}: the second lady in scenes with two of them. {dynamic}: how the scene plays out given their bond (from bonds.json dynamics). guidance is inserted wherever {guidance} appears.

Which prompt is used where: scene (client highlights), private (private time), train, proposition (date invitations), encounter (visits, lovers waiting), reckless, breakup, backstory, and one per shared scene type in bonds.json (shared, shared_rivals, shared_friend, shared_lesson, shared_bath). Add a shared scene with its own 'ai' key and add a matching prompt here.

outcomes._note: How the scene ends, filled into {outcome} (sentences; {name} = her name, {partner} = the client or Sam). The game picks one: drain (a restless demon feeds too deep), feed (a demon feeds), frustrated (left wanting), satisfied (she finishes), wanting (giving/kissing/massage: she doesn't finish and it leaves her wanting more), finish (added when the service makes him finish). Edit freely; empty strings are skipped.
outcomes.drain: {name} is a demon and feeds on {partner} as he finishes; tonight she is ravenous and drinks far too deep, leaving him drained and dazed while she glows with stolen energy.
outcomes.feed: {name} is a demon and quietly feeds on {partner}'s energy as he finishes, leaving her flushed and revitalized and him pleasantly tired.
outcomes.frustrated: {name} doesn't get to finish; it ends with her flushed, frustrated and still wanting.
outcomes.satisfied: {name} finishes and is left deeply satisfied.
outcomes.wanting: {name} doesn't finish herself; pleasing {partner} leaves her flushed, aroused and wanting more.
